about_the_game:
Marina and Marcello Forlani are the sibling design team behind the fashion label Forlani. But after their 2025 Milan collection is torn apart by critics, they’re in desperate need of a break. Luckily, an old friend offers the perfect escape: a stay at the luxurious Bibi Resort on the dreamy island of Fuente Grande.

Sun, style, and plenty of romance await. Between poolside cocktails, glittering soirées, and quiet walks along the beach, Marina and Marcello will meet an array of captivating women; each with her own charm, secrets, and stories.

Fun Times at the Bibi Resort and Hotel is a romantic comedy Visual Novel and Dating Sim. Play as Marina (a lesbian woman) or Marcello (a straight man) as you explore paradise and chase the possibility of love. Will you find your perfect match in the island breeze?

Features

  • Multiple romance routes and endings

  • Choice-driven storytelling with plenty of replay value

  • A glamorous luxury resort setting full of surprises

  • Beautiful anime art that brings every moment to life

  • A groovy smooth jazz soundtrack to set the mood

content_descriptors.notes: Being a dating sim featuring characters in their 20s and 30's set in a tropical resort, characters are frequently shown wearing revealing swimsuits. On their dates they are frequently shown consuming alcohol. Furthermore, they discuss topics like adult romantic relationships, pregnancies and infidelity.
